title: DocumentExtractionRequest
description: Published by core-api (documents module, via outbox) to the document-extraction-requests queue. Consumed by ai-service. At-least-once delivery: consumers must be idempotent on jobId.

messageId.description: Unique per published message; differs between redeliveries of the same job only if the outbox republishes.

jobId.description: Idempotency key for the extraction job.

patientId.description: Opaque patient identifier. Used by ai-service only to scope data; never to look up the patient.

extractorVersion.description: Extractor version requested by the core. Lets the core reprocess a document with a newer extractor.

objectKey.description: Opaque key with no personal data, e.g. documents/<uuid>.

sha256.description: Hex digest of the stored object; ai-service must verify it after download.

correlationId.description: Propagated for logs. Trace context travels in SQS message attributes, not in the body.
